# Equation Sheet {.unnumbered}

All results below, unless otherwise stated, refer to diploid individuals and autosomal loci. More general results are often given in the relevant sections.

::: column-page-right
| Quantity                                                             | Equation                                                                                                                            | Ref.                                                                              |
|:---------------------------------------------------------------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Relatedness (Inbreeding) coefficient                                 | $F_{ij}= 0 \times r_0 + ({}^{1}\!/\!{}_{4}) r_1  + ({}^{1}\!/\!{}_{2}) r_2$                                                         | ([-@eq-coeffkinship-step])                                                     |
| Generalized HWE                                                      | $(1-F) p^2 + F p,~(1-F) 2pq,~   (1-F) q^2 + F q$                                                                                    | [-@tbl-GeneralizedHWE]                                                         |
| Inbreeding coefficient                                               | $F = \sum_{i=1}^K \frac{1}{2^{n_i}} \big( 1+ f_{A_i} \big)$                                                                         | ([-@eq-inbreeding-over-ancs])                                                  |
| F statistics                                                         | $F_{\mathrm{IT}} =1-\frac{H_I}{H_T},~F_{\mathrm{IS}} =1-\frac{H_I}{H_S},~F_{\mathrm{ST}} =1-\frac{H_S}{H_T}$                        | ([-@eq-FIS])–([-@eq-FST]).                                                  |
| Relationship among F statistics                                      | $(1-F_{\mathrm{IT}}) =(1-F_{\mathrm{IS}})(1-F_{\mathrm{ST}})$                                                                       | ([-@eq-F-relationships])                                                       |
| Linkage disequilibrium (LD)                                          | $D = p_{AB} - p_Ap_B$                                                                                                               | ([-@eq-LD-def])                                                                |
| Decay of LD                                                          | $D_t=  (1-c)^t D_0$                                                                                                                 | ([-@eq-LD-decay])                                                              |
| Decay of Heterozygosity                                              | $H_t = \left(1-\frac{1}{2N_e} \right)^tH_0$                                                                                         | ([-@eq-loss-het-discrete])                                                     |
| Expectation of ${}^{d_N}\!/\!{}_{d_S}$                               | ${}^{d_N}\!/\!{}_{d_S} = (1-C-B) +  2 N B f_B$                                                                                      | ([-@eq-dNDS-C-B])                                                              |
| Model-based $F_{\mathrm{ST}}$ expectations.                          | $F_{\mathrm{ST}} = \frac{ T}{ T + 4N_e }, ~~~~F_{IM} = \frac{1}{1 + 4N_I m}$                                                        | ([-@eq-FST-split]), ([-@eq-FIM])                                            |
| Breeder’s equation                                                   | $R = h^2 S = V_A \beta = \frac{V_A}{\overline{w}} \frac{\partial \overline{w}}{\partial \bar{x}}$                                   | ([-@eq-breeders-eqn]), ([-@eq-R-beta]), ([-@eq-pheno-fitness-landscape]) |
| Multi-variate breeders equation                                      | $\bf{R} = \bf{G} \bf{V}^{-1} \bf{S} = \bf{G} \boldsymbol{ \beta}$                                                                   | ([-@eq-MV-breeders-eqn])                                                       |
| Hamilton’s Rule                                                      | $2 F_{i,j} B > C$                                                                                                                   | ([-@eq-Hamiltons-rule])                                                        |
| Frequency next generation (haploid & diploid).                       | $p_{t+1}  = \frac{w_1 }{\overline{w}} p_t , ~p_{t+1} = \frac{w_{11} p_t^2 + w_{12} p_tq_t}{\overline{w}}$                           | ([-@eq-deltap-haploid]), ([-@eq-deltap-dip1])                               |
| Haploid cumulative change (use ${}^{s}\!/\!{}_{2}$ for diploid case) | $p_{\tau} \approx \frac{p_0}{p_0 + q_0 e^{-s\tau}},~~~\tau \approx \frac{1}{s} \log \left(\frac{p_{\tau} q_0}{q_{\tau} p_0}\right)$ | ([-@eq-haploid-logistic-growth]) ([-@eq-estTauExplSimpl])                   |
| Heterozygote advantage equilibrium                                   | $p_e = \frac{s_2}{s_1+s_2}$                                                                                                         | ([-@eq-het-ad-eq])                                                             |
| Diploid mutation-selection equilibrium                               | $q_e = q_t = \frac{\mu}{hs},~~ q_e = \sqrt{\frac{\mu}{s}}~~(\textrm{if }h=0)$                                                       | ([-@eq-mut-sel-bal]), ([-@eq-recess-mut-sel-bal])                           |
| Migration-selection equil. & cline width.                            | $q_{e,1} = \frac{m}{hs},~~~~0.6 \sigma/\sqrt{s}$                                                                                    | ([-@eq-mig-sel-eq]), ([-@eq-cline-width])                                   |
| Prob. fixation for weakly selected alleles ($h={}^{1}\!/\!{}_{2}$)   | $P_F \left(\frac{1}{2N} \right) = \frac{1-e^{-s }}{1-e^{-2Ns}} \text{  ,~ $s<0$ for deleterious allele. }$                          | ([-@eq-new-mut-prob-fixed])                                                    |
:::
